headword: {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}

definitions.gloss: employee cafeteria; company canteen; staff dining hall
definitions.explanation: A dining facility within a company or office building that serves meals to employees, typically at subsidized prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat in the employee cafeteria at lunch.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Our employee cafeteria is cheap and delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧オフィスビル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new office building is fully equipped with an employee cafeteria.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ (company employee) and ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ (dining hall/cafeteria). Often abbreviated to ⟦{社食|しゃしょく}→社食：27579_shashoku⟧ in casual workplace conversation. Many Japanese companies provide subsidized meals in their cafeterias as an employee benefit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ — to eat in the cafeteria
- {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧ — the cafeteria menu
- {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧ — the cafeteria is well-equipped

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{社食|しゃしょく}→社食：27579_shashoku⟧ — company cafeteria (casual abbreviation)
- ⟦{学食|がくしょく}→学食：12241_gakushoku⟧ — university/school cafeteria (same abbreviation pattern)
- ⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ — dining hall, cafeteria (general term)
